description: The main window loads agentes.chat itself (D79): it may drag and zoom the window from its title bar, and ask this Mac what `this_mac` relays (status, connect, reconnect, a Preferences tab, the access requests). Its right-click menu may be drawn by the system (`context_menu`: items checked, choices go back into the page). It says when it painted (`page_ready`, the cover goes). No other app command, nothing else of the Mac.
